[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Prem Nisst''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked for [[Core to Rim Shipping]]. Nisst commanded the [[medium freighter]] ''[[Space Drifter]]'' and was a staunch support of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
